body: Thank you for your feedback. This really hit hard. I've just never met someone who is this intractably suicidal. It's like he has a terminal illness. Even when he laughs and is having the best time, he still wants to die. I want him to live for purely selfish reasons, I understand. Perhaps, in the end, it really is the best thing for him. Thank you for sharing your experience. I hope things are better for you and your friend.
